title: ERC-1155: Multi Token Standard
quote: A standard interface for contracts that manage multiple token types. A single deployed contract may include any combination of fungible tokens, non-fungible tokens or other configurations.

title: ERC-1155 — OpenZeppelin Contracts Docs
quote: a novel token standard that aims to take the best from previous standards to create a fungibility-agnostic and gas-efficient token contract. ... it uses a single smart contract to represent multiple tokens at once.

title: ERC-1155 Multi Token Standard
quote: any combination of fungible tokens, non-fungible tokens or other configurations (e.g., semi-fungible tokens) ... when the supply is just one, the token is essentially a non-fungible token (NFT).

title: ERCs/ERCS/erc-1155.md (canonical EIP-1155 source)
quote: Tokens standards like ERC-20 and ERC-721 require a separate contract to be deployed for each token type or collection. ... To make sure event order is correct in the case of valid re-entry (e.g. if a receiver contract forwards tokens on receipt) state balance and events balance MUST match before calling an external contract.

title: ERC-1155 Multi Token Standard
quote: safeBatchTransferFrom consumed 132,437 gas versus 189,861 gas for three separate safeTransferFrom calls ... ERC-1155 contracts are susceptible to re-entrancy attacks ... recommending adherence to checks-effects-interactions pattern and/or implementing reentrancy locks.

title: OpenZeppelin Contracts — ERC1155 module
quote: Extensions: ERC1155Burnable, ERC1155Pausable, ERC1155Supply (adds totalSupply tracking), ERC1155URIStorage; ERC1155Supply specifically provides totalSupply tracking, which is not included in the base implementation.

title: Metadata Standards — OpenSea Developer Documentation
quote: For OpenSea to pull metadata for ERC721 and ERC1155 assets, your contract will need to return a URI ... OpenSea uses the tokenURI method in ERC721 and the uri method in ERC1155.

title: ERC-6464: Multi-operator, per-token ERC-721 approvals
quote: setApprovalForAll has been established as the predominant way to authorise operators, which affords the approved address control over all assets and creates an unnecessarily broad security risk that has already been exploited in a multitude of phishing attacks.

title: ERC-5216: ERC-1155 Allowance Extension
quote: An extension to ERC-1155 to standardize the use of allowances for single token IDs, complementing the all-or-nothing setApprovalForAll operator model of the base standard.

title: What is a token approval? — MetaMask Help Center
quote: setApprovalForAll ... gives access to every NFT in that collection. ... Consider revoking approvals after use, and review operator lists regularly.

title: What is ERC-1155? Understanding its role in blockchain
quote: ERC-1155 can be more complex to implement and manage than simpler token standards ... it may not be as widely supported by wallets, exchanges, and other infrastructure as ERC-721.
